cards.text: You give Des one address. He doesn't write it down.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Fate. In the City, no less." He's pleased in a way that takes a second to read as pleased. "That's one. Somebody'll have something by the weekend."

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "Still want physics off you an' all. No rush — just don't go thinking that's the job done."
By the end of the week, one patch you found has a vein in it and it isn't yours. You seem fine with this.
